item.name: Enumerate returns all the jobs currently known to the system

request.name: Enumerate returns all the jobs currently known to the system

query.description:
Type if specified will list the jobs of the provided type.

 - UNSPECIFIED_TYPE: Unspecified
 - NONE: None
 - DRAIN_ATTACHMENTS: Job for draining volume attachments
 - CLOUD_DRIVE_TRANSFER: Job for transferring cloud drives between nodes
 - COLLECT_DIAGS: Job for collecting diags from the cluster nodes
 - DEFRAG: Job for storage defragmentation on cluster nodes

response.name: A successful response.

item.name:
Update updates an existing job's state
Only acceptable state values are
JobState_PAUSED - acceptable only from running state
JobState_CANCELLED - acceptable only from running/pause state
JobState_RUNNING - acceptable only from pause state
